$comment: Every search operation (a JSON body that takes both page and sort) gets a success-path test sending page.limit and a sort, and an offset test; with auto set the entries are derived from the spec, so a new search operation is covered without editing this file. The derived choice is created, else updated, else deleted (whichever the sort enum offers), descending, with its order asserted (and the opposite sort compared); if the operation has none, the first enum field ascending, without an order assertion, because names sort by the database collation. 'searches' holds only the exceptions: searchCatalogAssets and searchWorkspaces also send a filter, since none of their other success tests do. 'exclude' lists operations that get no paging test, each with the reason (none today).
